menu.title: MENU
keyword.DEVOUR:
DEVOUR: remove a card from the game.
It goes to the devoured pile.
keyword.SUPPLANT:
SUPPLANT: assassinate a troop where you have presence,
then deploy your own troop in its place.
keyword.DEPLOY:
DEPLOY: put a troop from your barracks on a free space
where you have presence.
keyword.ASSASSINATE:
ASSASSINATE: remove a troop where you have presence.
It goes to your trophy hall (1 VP each).
keyword.PLACE:
PLACE A SPY: put a spy on a site.
It gives you presence there and counts for control.
keyword.RETURN:
RETURN: send a troop or spy where you have presence
back to its owner.
keyword.PROMOTE:
PROMOTE: move a card into your Inner Circle.
It leaves your deck and scores its Inner Circle VP.
keyword.RECRUIT: RECRUIT: take a card into your discard pile.
keyword.FOCUS:
FOCUS: works if you played another card of this aspect
this turn or reveal one from your hand.
keyword.DEVOTION: DEVOTION: works when you recruit or promote this card.
keyword.GLAMOUR:
GLAMOUR: spend 1 VP token (back to the supply) to switch this ability on.
Only one Glamour per card.
keyword.TRANSFORM: TRANSFORM: this card turns into the stronger card it names.

setup.deck_tip_drow:
DROW: the classic toolkit.
Spies, supplants and promotions, steady and even.
setup.deck_tip_dragons:
DRAGONS: lots of Influence and Power.
Big dragons pay VP for sites, total control and trophies.
setup.deck_tip_demons:
DEMONS: madness.
Hand opponents Insane Outcasts, devour cards to thin your deck.
setup.deck_tip_elementals:
ELEMENTALS: Focus.
A card gets a bonus if you play another card of its aspect.
setup.deck_tip_aberrations:
ABERRATIONS: mind control.
Opponents discard; play cards from your inner circle or the market.
setup.deck_tip_undead:
UNDEAD: sacrifice.
Devour your own cards for strong one-time effects.
setup.deck_tip_celestial:
CELESTIAL: order and growth.
House Guards, spies, promotions; dragons Transform.
setup.deck_tip_shadow:
RAVENLOFT: curses.
Floods the table with Insane Outcasts and profits from them.
setup.deck_tip_piltover:
WATERDEEP: Focus combos.
Obedience cards, Double Focus, even an extra turn.
setup.deck_tip_siege:
SIEGE: variety.
Play cards of different aspects in one turn to unlock bonuses.
setup.deck_tip_mercenaries:
MERCENARIES: Bribe.
Give a rival 1 VP for a stronger effect; lots of VP.
setup.deck_tip_noxus:
AVERNUS: Execute and Might.
Devour cards this turn to power up Might effects.
setup.deck_tip_freljord:
ICEWIND DALE: Frostbite.
Cards fire when discarded from hand; make others discard.
setup.deck_tip_shurima:
CALIMSHAN: Devotion.
Cards fire when recruited or promoted; recruit and promote a lot.
setup.deck_tip_ionia:
KARA-TUR: Retain.
Keep cards in hand for your next turn and build big combos.
setup.deck_tip_bandle:
FEYWILD: Glamour.
Spend 1 VP to switch on extra card abilities.
setup.deck_tip_void:
FAR REALM: the swarm.
Deploy a lot and grow by controlling sites.
setup.deck_tip_ixtal:
CHULT: Explore.
Look at the top of your deck and pull the cards you need into your hand.
setup.god_tip:
Card testing: give yourself any cards, place troops and spies,
add Power, Influence and VP, switch turns. No turn timer.
